text:
Ravi: FYI large payer wants a sealed-network POC. Questions: do we support couriered USB vs. signed jumpbox pull, what's upgrade cadence, and what's the commercial uplift for concierge staging? Also they sent a security questionnaire.

Tess: They prefer physical media for initial load. Follow-ups: SBOM, signer proof, and CVE SLA (they want 30 days for critical).

Marco: We can provide SBOM JSON + signer cert chain. Signing happens inside an HSM (FIPS 140-2/3 depending on cert). We will not export private keys. Can offer an HSM attestation under NDA.

Eden: Operational notes: full bundle ~11GB compressed. We produce delta minibundles (~<200MB) for security fixes. For limited-transfer sites we split into 500MB chunks and include sha256 manifest + tiny reassembly helper.

Ravi: Great. What about cadence and patching policy?

Marco: Recommend monthly security minibundles and quarterly feature rollups. Emergency hotfix channel: 48-72h SLA optional (extra fee) if they need faster than standard cadence.

Tess: Commercials: one-time packaging+signing fee, plus concierge support uplift. Ballpark: add ~15% to Dedicated rates for the first quarter, then normalize. I'll draft a quote line item for chunking PS (10-16h).

Legal: For questionnaire: propose wording: "We deliver an SBOM and signer certificate chain. Signing is performed by HSM; private keys never leave the HSM. Audit logs and HSM attestation available under NDA." Will redact logs.

OpsBot: Reminder: include offline license activation token workflow in the runbook. Provide CLI steps for offline import and verification hashes.

Eden: Example snippet we can share for chunk verify:
```
sha256sum part_* > parts.sha256
redwood-sign verify --manifest parts.sha256 --cert signer.crt
cat part_* > bundle.tar.gz && tar -tzf bundle.tar.gz
```

Marco: Note on rekeys: offline cert rotation supported but requires signed rotation bundle and maintenance window. Recommend quarterly rotation unless compliance demands otherwise.

Ravi: Plan: Tess produce pricing lines; Marco & Eden author runbook + verification commands; Legal finalize questionnaire answers. I'll send consolidated reply tomorrow morning. Any blockers?

Tess: Compliance asked for SBOM sample before final approval; Marco please attach a sanitized SBOM.

Marco: Will prepare a redacted SBOM and upload link.

Legal: Don't include private key material in the upload.

Ravi: Thanks everyone.
